Data quality notes

Genus abundances are derived from Greengenes OTU counts. The denominator includes all retained OTU reads, including those without genus assignments. Such reads remain in the denominator, but are not tested as named genera. The 1,000-read minimum is an exploratory QC choice. Duplicated visit records, body-site conflicts and unmatched metadata are excluded. Age, BMI and SSPG are subject-level portal values.

Methods & provenance

Study and inclusion

Loading dataset provenance…

Statistics

Categorical metadata: two-sided permutation Wilcoxon rank-sum test with average ranks for ties. Effect: rank-biserial correlation, positive for higher values in the comparison category. Race and study enrollment use a selected two-category comparison; other categories are excluded. Each category requires at least five participants. Race codes are retained as recorded, without inferring ancestry or biological explanations. Study enrollment describes recruitment, not a randomized exercise intervention. Continuous metadata: Spearman rank correlation with a two-sided permutation test. 4,999 label permutations, seed 17421; p = (extreme + 1) / 5,000. Benjamini–Hochberg correction includes every nonconstant feature passing the selected participant prevalence filter. FDR is per analysis, not across multiple exploratory runs.

Selected categorical features show the median difference in percentage points and a 95% percentile bootstrap interval (1,999 independent within-group resamples, seed 997). This interval is exploratory and not multiplicity-adjusted. No age, BMI, medication or other confounder adjustment is applied. These are relative-abundance associations, not estimates of absolute microbial load. Aggregating visits gives equal weight to each person but does not model visit timing or within-person change.

Literature

Evidence cards were researched by literature agents on 17 October 2026, with links and taxonomic limitations. They are contextual evidence; presence of a card does not validate a cohort result. Live Europe PMC searches retrieve candidate titles and abstracts and do not run a synthesis agent. A configured server-side model service is required for on-demand agent interpretation.

Legacy Greengenes genus labels may not map cleanly to current species literature. Genus-level evidence is not strain-specific evidence. Subject-level age and BMI are not confirmed visit-specific measurements. Switching the source to counts does not make this a count-regression, CLR or DREAM analysis.
